migrations.risk: High application-integrity risk because this introduces the durable message, change, attention, outbox, and receipt aggregate. Apply-time risk is bounded: the migration is additive, copies no legacy comment or message data, and database triggers preserve exact Project scope even when foreign keys are disabled. DM-shaped rows are explicitly rejected until the later DM authorization task enables them.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable conversation sends and creation through the server controls while retaining all additive tables, receipts, and acknowledged history. Do not drop the schema as an operational rollback. Removing stored conversation data is a separately authorized destructive data operation.
postconditions: all seven Project Conversation aggregate tables exist
one project conversation is enforced per canonical workspaces.id
workspace membership insert, delete, and update writers advance conversation audience epochs
workspace archive and restore advance the epoch and synchronize conversation lifecycle
message, change, receipt, attention, and outbox guards reject mismatched source relationships even with foreign keys disabled
conversation_outbox stores source identity and revision but no message body
migration is additive and copies no legacy comments
